COP1009.title: Beauty and Joy of Computing
COP1009.prerequisites: None in the statewide record; Florida Poly asks only for basic computer skills. No programming experience is assumed - this is a 2-credit introduction for beginners (Snap! then Python), not Florida Poly's first programming course for computer science majors, which is COP2034 or COP2271. *** One carrier (Florida Polytechnic). Transfer is guaranteed only to an institution offering the same course, so elsewhere expect ELECTIVE credit; it does not substitute for COP1000/COP2000 or COP2034. Ask an adviser whether it counts toward your Florida Poly degree or only as a free elective.

offering_notes.summary: One public carrier, Florida Polytechnic University, at 2 credits. New number: created February 2025, effective August 2025.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida's 15-hours-per-credit convention on 2 credits, matching the Spring 2026 syllabus's meeting pattern (two 50-minute meetings a week, labs inside the meetings). No total is published.

offerings.title: Beauty and Joy of Computing
offerings.note: Description is the statewide text. Spring 2026 syllabus: Snap! for the first half, Python (Colab, pandas, regular expressions) for the second; reference texts Blown to Bits and Python for Everybody; outcomes mapped to the CS programme's ABET outcomes. Prerequisite: basic computer skills. Florida Poly's CS majors start with COP2034 (Python) or COP2271 (C).
